actionable_steps.step: Develop faith in yourself first — question 'Do I exist?', hear 'Yes, I do exist' — that is true faith.

actionable_steps.citation: Dedicate your lives to the Divine — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-12-25
actionable_steps.step: Cultivate self-confidence — how can one without confidence in himself have faith in God?

actionable_steps.citation: Be prepared for a life of sacrifice — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-01-19
actionable_steps.step: Keep faith like your life-breath — steady through joy and sorrow, loss and gain, pain and pleasure, whether desires are fulfilled or not.

actionable_steps.citation: Dedicate your lives to the Divine — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-12-25
actionable_steps.step: Make faith unwavering, total, and free from doubts of any kind — and put the stamp of prema (love) on it.

actionable_steps.citation: Anything In Life Can Be Achieved With Faith In God — SSS Vol 40 (2007), 2007-12-26
actionable_steps.step: Keep your faith firm even when your desires are not fulfilled — do not lose faith when results do not come.

actionable_steps.citation: Duty of resistance to Adharma — SSS Vol 19 (1986), 1986-10-11
actionable_steps.step: Let your faith be evident — wherever you are, let your actions show that you believe in the oneness of God.

definition.quote: Faith is life; absence of faith is death. Only the body dies; the Atma (Divine Self) is beyond birth and death. Aware of this, one is soaked in Ananda (Divine Bliss).

discourses.quote: First develop faith in yourself. Where there is faith, there is love. Where there is love, there is peace. Where there is peace, there is truth. Where there is truth, there is God. Where there is God, there is bliss.

discourses.citation: Make Faith The Basis Of Your Life — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-07
discourses.quote: Faith is the basis of your love for your mother, father, husband, wife, etc... Without faith, one cannot experience love and derive bliss. It is not possible to live in this world without faith.

discourses.citation: Be prepared for a life of sacrifice — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-01-19
discourses.quote: Faith should be like your life-breath, which goes on inhaling and exhaling at all times without respite... Like your lifebreath, your faith should remain steady, through joy and sorrow, loss and gain, pain and pleasure.
Atma Jnana can be got only by faith and love. Develop faith in yourself and faith in God. This is the secret of greatness.

make_it_real: Faith is life — breathe it like air, hold it steady through joy and sorrow, and let your life show it.
title: Faith

vahinis.quote: Developing faith in the Atma principle and loving it earnestly —this is the real worship. The Atma is the one and only Loved One for humanity. Feel that it is more lovable than any object here or hereafter —that is the true adoration one can offer to God.
